name: Right Lung
short_description: The larger of the two lungs, located on the right side of the chest, responsible for gas exchange.

name: Left Lung
short_description: The smaller of the two lungs, located on the left side of the chest, also responsible for gas exchange.

name: Trachea
short_description: The windpipe that carries air to and from the lungs.

name: Bronchi
short_description: The two main branches of the trachea that lead into the lungs.
